scientific_integrity: The finding is narrowed to the correct and apparently original cube boundary norm and surface-volume asymptotic; a previously overlooked general comparison theorem is explicitly credited. Finite exact checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The general strict ordering for symmetric convex bodies was published in October 2026 and is excluded from originality.
The exact uniform-volume cube projector and vertex norming were independently published and are used as inputs.
Boundary measure is physical surface measure only because all cube facets have equal cone heights.
No higher-degree, nonuniform-sampling, or arbitrary-convex-body norm formula.
Unindexed earlier exact surface-cube calculations remain a historical novelty risk.
scientific_scope: Affine least-squares projections on uniform cube surface and uniform cube volume, all dimensions d>=2; exact boundary norm, vertex norming and sharp asymptotic difference. Previously published universal cone-volume ordering and volume-cube norm are credited premises.
title: Exact cone-boundary affine projection on cubes and its sharp surface–volume gap
